social_circle.name: Rosa Guevara

demographics.occupation: medical office receptionist and front desk assistant
demographics.education: high school diploma plus some community college classes

background.how_they_met: Rosa is Saba's mother and raised her in Yuba City in a Mexican American and Uzbek/Central Asian household.
background.why_close: Saba talks to Rosa most when stressed, especially about money, work, health, and family responsibilities. They share cooking, errands, cultural rituals, and practical problem-solving.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in caring but direct bursts, often with reminders, practical questions, and check-ins. Uses some Spanish phrases, voice notes when explaining family plans, and expects replies when Saba is out late.

shared_activities: candles and Dia de los Muertos rituals
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Saba got home safely after closing shifts.
Reminding Saba about budgeting, dental payments, appointments, and eating before work.
Planning groceries, Sunday meals, family gatherings, and whether Timur needs a ride.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Rosa is 'the person I talk to most, especially when I am stressed about money or work.' Q43: 'My mom notices fast.' Q103-Q104 document Rosa's medical office role and duties.
